feature_contract.goal: Prevent original +TIME direct HUD scope from contaminating an earlier unknown/mixed ID3DXSprite GPU Flush/End while preserving valid exact +TIME batches, queued sibling ownership and unchanged original game Draw/FFB.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact direct StageExtensionTime physical D3DX Flush/End only; do not change GOAL, lens/SkyGlow, F11, rank, DX11, frozen DXVK, R26_SAFE or original GPU HRESULT.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Unknown preexisting native D3DX GPU triangles cannot acquire StageExtensionTime from a later E8 scope; fail-closed original draw remains.
Verified +TIME direct and queued batches retain exact GPU source; GOAL/world/other owner and one-shot pending state preserved.
Required same SHA Actions pass; HMD validation remains UNTESTED.

trace_stages: Original EXE 0x498670 stage transition: exact 0x9898E and 0x98A36 sprani plus 0x989AD,0x98A10,0x98A89 numeric HUD callers are scoped as StageExtensionTime; mode=2 sprani 0x98AC6 remains distinct.

Original direct ID3DXSprite::Draw queues CPU-side D3DX triangles; on a later physical Flush/End the tracked exact homogeneous producer can be restored, whereas unknown/mixed earlier native triangle batches have no StageExtensionTime provenance.

At real ID3DXSprite FlushDest and EndDest only, unproven prior direct +TIME scope is temporarily masked to None, allowing R84 R33/R30 or original fallback without inventing left/right ScreenHud eye ownership; native original HRESULT and queue scope are preserved.

At original +TIME producer return, the exact scoped owner, pending one-shot, previously queued SpriteNode selection and candidate OpenXR per-eye source are restored; actual binocular visibility is pending HMD evidence.
subcomponents: Implement bounded physical native D3DX Flush and End ownership suppression for a preceding unproven/mixed direct +TIME GPU batch rather than treating an inactive ScopedExactProducerSemantic(None) as isolation.
Preserve exact homogeneous +TIME sprite and numeric owner and the queued SpriteNode path while protecting GOAL, lens centre/outer rings, SceneEffect/SkyGlow and unrelated one-shot pending semantics.

Add constexpr positive/negative classification tests for known direct batch, queue-active, other overlay scope, other GOAL producer and world effect; preserve source/eye fallback and unmodified original D3DX HRESULT.

diagnosis.root_cause: On a failed GPU batch-owner restoration check, FlushDest and EndDest used ScopedExactProducerSemantic(None) (inactive), leaving the live StageExtensionTime direct scope to classify a physically submitted earlier unproven GPU batch.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material native C++ and constexpr guard commit 48f46e1e4bc62ffe2c77c5e693ae16afa6b76549; initial Active policy job failed on incomplete run feature_contract trace/subcomponents, not compilation, and is repaired as C6 validation record under the same TASK_ID.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Original game +TIME stage source is 0x498670; exact stage sprites (0x9898E, 0x98A36) and numerical +TIME producers (0x989AD,0x98A10,0x98A89) invoke native D3DX Draw which may defer submission until native Flush/End.
source_trace: Original EXE 0x498670 stage transition: exact 0x9898E and 0x98A36 sprani plus 0x989AD,0x98A10,0x98A89 numeric HUD callers are scoped as StageExtensionTime; mode=2 sprani 0x98AC6 remains distinct.

Original direct ID3DXSprite::Draw queues CPU-side D3DX triangles; on a later physical Flush/End the tracked exact homogeneous producer can be restored, whereas unknown/mixed earlier native triangle batches have no StageExtensionTime provenance.

At real ID3DXSprite FlushDest and EndDest only, unproven prior direct +TIME scope is temporarily masked to None, allowing R84 R33/R30 or original fallback without inventing left/right ScreenHud eye ownership; native original HRESULT and queue scope are preserved.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only a proven exact StageExtensionTime direct D3DX GPU batch can enter R84 exact ScreenHud binocular projection; an unknown/mixed older batch now uses native fallback without borrowing the active stage parent. This is static code-path correctness, not HMD visual verification.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally flush D3DX Draw or treat texture/FVF/alpha as proof of +TIME; do not relabel a queued stage, mixed result, GOAL, centre lens or SkyGlow frame; do not suppress a native GPU Draw.
